utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. I can swing by later and see if they need any extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Really? Are they actually still taking donations this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I think so — they were still sorting things this morning, so donations should still help. I’ll check when I swing by and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I can help spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep repeating the plan to folks and let them know if anything updates.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free to help with the repair drive. Tell me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a hammer, a roll of duct tape, and a box of screws? That’d really help us get started.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring those over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — could you help sort and count the donated supplies, then set aside anything we’re still missing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can sort and count the supplies, then set aside what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school pickup times, just tell me when the repair drive is set for.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — I don’t have the final repair drive time yet, but I’ll tell you as soon as it’s set so we can work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — just let me know when it’s set and I’ll plan around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when do you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, simple is good — I’m thinking we start at 9 and just sort the donations as they come in. If you can be there a little before that, it’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—I’ll be there a little before 9 and ready to sort.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in—count me in for the repair drive! I’ll spread the word and see who else can help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn—that’d really help. I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got the timing and supplies sorted so it doesn’t turn into a scramble.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—what time are you thinking, and what supplies should I tell folks to bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’ve got three homes lined up so far, and I’m finalizing the volunteer list today. If you want, I can tell you which supplies we still need most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—what supplies are still needed most?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the repair drive details before I do anything. What’s the main thing you want me to verify?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you verify the date, drop-off location, and what items they’re accepting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll verify those three things: the date, drop-off location, and accepted items. I’ll get back to you once I’ve checked them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I’ll need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — I can jump in a bit later and keep it simple too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll put together the basics and let you know what I can handle.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I can lend a hand with the repair drive. Just tell me what tools you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — do you have a wrench set and a screwdriver, or should I grab them?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got both right here — a wrench set and a screwdriver you can borrow. Just swing by when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with that—where should I note the repair drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Put it on Maple Street by the community shed—thanks!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Maple Street by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools over for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what we need as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Rey — just give me a shout when you’ve got the list, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the pickup time and where everything’s going first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the pickup time and the destination first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes—once I have the pickup time and destination, I can confirm on my side.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect people for the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Start with the folks who already mentioned broken lamps or leaky faucets, then the block captains—they’ll know who needs help most.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll start with the folks who mentioned broken lamps or leaky faucets, then check in with the block captains.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over extra screws, tape, and a flashlight for the repair drive. Let me know what else you still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — that covers a lot. I’ll swing by late and see if we still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll set them aside and keep an eye out for anything else we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—people around here have been pretty generous. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate that. School pickup and the drive have me juggling a lot, so any update helps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll watch for any updates and send them your way. Hopefully it’ll all settle into place soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with that—what’s the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — it’s a neighborhood repair drive to help folks with small fixes like leaky faucets, loose steps, and broken screens. I’m organizing volunteers and supplies, and I’d love your help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — can you help sort the donated items and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated items and label the boxes. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to invite a few more neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—that’d be great. I’m still getting the updates second-hand, so the more folks who know, the better.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll get the word out to a few more neighbors right away. If you want, I can also ask them to bring tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where exactly is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s at the community center parking lot on Maple, Saturday morning. If you want, I can give you the exact time and what they’re taking.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes please—what time does it start, and what are they taking?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get the parts it needed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — let me check the details before I say for certain.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, can you let me know once you’ve checked?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep things moving on my end and see who else can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’m headed out now, so I’ll spread the word and see if anyone can help.
